summary: Mingteng International Corporation Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, China-based metal building-products issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice of an extraordinary general meeting and proxy statement for a November 20, 2026 EGM (Beijing time). The sole substantive proposal is a five-for-one share consolidation of Class A and Class B ordinary shares, par value rising from US$0.00005 to US$0.00025, effective December 2, 2026, plus a conforming amended and restated memorandum and articles and an adjournment proposal. The board recommends FOR all proposals. This is a routine capital-structure/meeting matter, not a special situation; no price, premium or deal terms apply. Watch for shareholder approval and post-consolidation trading dynamics.
